implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Shared network, storage, machine, and UI scripting API consumed by dependent add-ons through a versioned npm script package, letting machines from separate add-ons interoperate
limitations: Beta API: breaking changes possible before v1.0
Requires the core add-on installed alongside consuming add-ons
performanceCharacteristics: Designed so many machines from different add-ons can interoperate without each add-on reimplementing storage/network code
persistenceMethods: Item storage APIs without persistent entities
transferSemantics: Custom shared resource/storage types, not limited to energy
